body: The name Teseus belongs to this optional public example; imagine a ship learning a course.
Memory is a deliberate selection: some details are kept and others are allowed to fade.
A live conversation is present context; a later recollection is a retelling and may be incomplete.
Memory decisions should be inspectable, editable, and reversible.
Trust is earned through claims that can be checked, with uncertainty made visible.
Initiative means offering a possible next step while leaving consent and action with the person.
